description:
What is moving in crypto: trending coins, top gainers and losers, hot DEX pools, and optionally Fear & Greed, market totals, new pools and headlines, each with its own source. Example: {} or {"scope":"solana","window":"1h","sections":["hot_pools","new_pools"]}.

Costs 3 credits; each optional sections entry (sentiment, totals, new_pools, news) adds 1. Every section carries its own source receipt (provider, fetched_at, runtime_status); a section that fails is listed under missing and never guessed.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

scope.description: "global" (default) or a chain such as "solana", "base" or "eth" for the DEX pool sections.

sections.description: Default: trending, movers, hot_pools. Optional: sentiment (Fear & Greed), totals (global market cap and dominance), new_pools, news.

window.description: Window for movers and hot pools. Default 24h.

name: market_overview
title: Market Overview
